verdicts.reason: A has broken decorative elements: a large white diamond is glued to 'since 1980', which pushes that line off the centre axis, and a second stray diamond sits on top of the resume in the photo. That is an obvious unwanted collision. B is a near-faithful copy of the original. Its only flaws are that the two flanking dots by 'since 1980' are slightly uneven and the short second rule under the top and bottom lines has been dropped.
